text:
Noor: We're still seeing old PM action items stick around. Suggest a small 'action-lifecycle' bot to nudge owners and track SLAs.
Ben: Good call. Keep the pings minimal. Weekly summary in #incidents + DMs for overdue items only.
Carla: Could we require owner ack within 48h of assignment? If no ack -> auto-escalate to team lead.
Tomas: Add recurrence detection: if an action matches a past PM phrase (error code, service name) surface the earlier PM link. Helps avoid rework.
Noor: Proposed SLA: P0/P1 = 14 days, P2 = 30 days. Runner posts a short summary and creates an escalation ticket when overdue > 7 days past SLA.
PagerBot: Cron registered: /action-lifecycle every Mon 09:00 UTC 3 will DM owners for overdue items.
Carla: Minimal PM timeline snippet to include in docs:
- rca_published: 2d
- actions_assigned: 5d
- remediation_review: 14d
- verify_close: 30d
- related_incidents: []
Noor: Next steps: Tomas + Ben build an MVP that reads the tracker, groups by owner, posts DM + weekly summary. I'll write escalation rules.
Ben: I'll test recurrence heuristics with 5 historical PMs.
Tomas: Will prototype and share example messages.
Noor: If this works we roll to SRE + Eng. :thumbsup:
